title: Move In Specialist
description:
CRS is a Phoenix-based company that helps insured families recover after unexpected home damage (fire, water, storm, earthquake, etc.) by providing temporary housing and relocation support. Working closely with insurance carriers, CRS manages everything from emergency hotel stays to long term housing, furniture, and necessities. In addition to housing placement services, we also streamline the repair and restoration process for damaged homes by tapping into our national network of general contractors. Since 1989, the company has built a reputation for reliability and world class, compassionate customer care powered by a team of professionals dedicated to supporting people during critical moments. Our goal is to make a difficult situation easier by coordinating housing solutions that fit the policyholder’s needs while also working within the guidelines of their insurance coverage.

Our office is in North Phoenix, off the North 101 Loop and 19th Ave. in Deer Valley.

As part of our commitment to a safe and trusted workplace, CRS requires all new hires to complete a pre-employment background check and drug screening.

CRS is an equal opportunity employer. We hire, develop, and promote individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment in service to one another, our diverse clients, and the communities we call home. We do this with kindness, empathy and respect for each other.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Move In Specialist to help customers complete the final steps needed to move into temporary housing after an insurance-covered loss, such as a fire, flood, or storm. This is mainly an administrative position. The role involves reviewing documents, entering information into company systems, following up on missing items, coordinating with several departments, and making sure every part of the move-in is completed correctly and on time. The Move In Specialist works with customers, insurance adjusters, landlords, property managers, furniture providers, and internal CRS teams. The person in this role must be highly organized, comfortable managing several claims at once, and able to catch errors before they cause delays or additional costs.

  • Compensation: $22.00/hr (approx. $45,760/yr). Monthly performance bonuses supplement the hourly pay.
  • Training: approximately 90 days, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM (in-office). Due to the nature of the training, we ask you do not request PTO during the training period.
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  • Hybrid: (after 3 month training period, based on consistent performance) 1 day in office, 4 days remote per week
  • Computer and phone equipment will be provided. You must have reliable high-speed internet service and a suitable workspace at your residence.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Review assigned temporary housing claims and determine what is still needed before the customer can move in.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, insurance adjusters, landlords, property managers, and internal departments by phone and email.
  • Work to arrange furniture, appliances, and household items for the temporary home.
  • Confirm deadlines and important dates throughout every step of the process..
  • Complete final confirmation calls with customers before they move in.
  • Explain important move-in details and answer customer questions.
  • Follow up on missing leases, signatures, approvals, payments, and other required documents.
  • Finalize the move-in in the CRS system once all requirements have been completed.
  • Enter accurate and detailed notes in Salesforce or other company systems.
  • Review insurance coverage information to make sure costs remain within the available housing allowance.
  • Identify and report possible errors, delays, missing information, or costs that have not been approved.
  • Resolve customer questions or concerns promptly and professionally.
  • Escalate urgent or complicated problems to management when needed.
  • Provide overflow coverage for housing calls during periods of high call volume.
  • Assist with reports, claim research, audits, and performance tracking.
  • Work outside of the normal schedule when needed, especially during major storms, wildfires, natural disasters, or other high-volume periods.

Daily Expectations:

  • The Move-In Specialist is expected to:
  • Manage multiple claims and deadlines at the same time.
  • Review the assigned workload throughout the day.
  • Respond to customers, adjusters, landlords, and internal teams in a timely manner.
  • Maintain accurate and current claim notes.
  • Complete follow-ups and close outstanding tasks.
  • Use the required move-in checklist and follow CRS procedures.
  • Stay available through the company’s phone, email, messaging, and claim-management systems.
  • Ask questions or request support when information is unclear.
  • Take responsibility for assigned claims and follow tasks through completion.
  • Meet established production, quality, phone, and service expectations.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • At least three years of customer service experience required.
  • Administrative, insurance, accounting, auditing, housing, property-management, or document-review experience preferred.
  • Experience reviewing contracts, leases, invoices, financial records, or detailed documents is helpful.
  • Previous experience working in a deadline-driven office or remote environment is preferred.

title: Director of People Digital & Insights​
description:
At AIA we’ve started an exciting movement to create a healthier, more sustainable future for everyone.

As pioneering innovators for over 100 years, we’re now transforming our organisation to be faster, simpler and more connected. Because we want to be even better equipped to develop digital solutions and experiences that help more people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

To get there, we need people with tech/digital/analytics expertise and passion to help develop positive, sustainable change through digitally enhanced experiences that will impact the lives of millions of people and create a healthier future for everyone.

If you believe in developing a better tomorrow, read on.

About the Role

Lead and shape the Group-wide People Analytics strategy to deliver actionable business insights to the Business, enhance HR operational efficiency, and elevate manager / employee experience.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Transformation

  • Define and execute the HR People Analytics strategy, aligned with Group HR’s objectives.
  • Identify and drive advance analytics initiatives including predictive modeling, machine learning and AI applications in HR and Workforce Planning.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for data-driven improvements in employee experience, performance, and engagement.
  • Champion and drive Data Quality across the Group for the key Critical Data Elements identified for the HR Function.

Data, Analytics & Reporting

  • Define standards, governance, and quality assurance for HR data sets and analytics.
  • Serve as domain expert and advisor in human capital analytics, building capability among HR teams.
  • Design, develop, and own self-service reporting tools and regulatory/management reports.
  • Provide advanced analytics, modeling, and actionable insights to support data-driven decisions across the talent lifecycle (recruitment to exit).
  • Deliver group-wide and function reporting (e.g., ESG, Gallup engagement survey) and drive analytics projects.

Data Quality and Governance

title: Youth & Young Adult Pastor
description:
Job Description


The Youth & Young Adults Pastor serves the Soldotna Campus by advancing Church on the Rock’s Purpose and Vision through pastoral leadership of youth (grades 6–12) and young adult (ages 18–25) ministries. The Soldotna Campus is a setup-and-tear-down campus that meets in a school gym. This role includes both spiritual leadership and hands-on responsibility for creating excellent ministry environments in a shared, portable space.

This position provides consistent discipleship, raises up leaders and Serve Team members, plans gatherings and events, and integrates these ministries into the broader life of the church in alignment with our Purpose, Values, and Campus Constants.

The Youth & Young Adults Pastor reports directly to the Campus Pastor and works collaboratively with the campus team, Central Support, Executive Team, and Central Leadership. This is a pastoral position requiring a minimum of 32 hours per week, including regular office hours and weekend responsibilities. The position is accountable for all stated duties in a way that reflects the heart and mission of Church on the Rock.


Leadership Structure:

Lead Pastor / Executive Leadership

Campus Pastor

Youth & Young Adults Pastor


Responsibilities & Duties

  • Provide spiritual leadership, pastoral care, and consistent discipleship for students (grades 6–12) and young adults (ages 18–25).
  • Plan and lead weekly gatherings that are biblically grounded, engaging, and aligned with the Purpose, Vision, and Values of Church on the Rock.
  • Build and lead Serve Teams of adult and student leaders for both youth and young adult ministries.
  • Develop and implement outreach strategies to connect with students and young adults in the church and broader community.
  • Organize and oversee special events, camps, retreats, and mission opportunities that foster connection and spiritual growth.
  • Collaborate with parents, volunteers, and pastoral staff to support the faith formation of the next generation.
  • Maintain regular, clear communication with parents, leaders, and students.
  • Support intentional transitions between ministries (Kids to Youth, Youth to Young Adults, Young Adults into church-wide engagement).
  • Attend weekly Soldotna Campus Staff Meeting, All-Campus Programming Meeting, and Pre-Service Meetings as needed.


Environments, Setup & Operations

  • Lead and participate in the weekly setup and tear-down of youth and young adult ministry environments within the shared school gym space.
  • Create welcoming, excellent temporary environments for students and young adults despite the portable nature of the campus.
  • Manage storage, inventory, care, and transport of portable youth ministry equipment and resources.
  • Collaborate closely with the Campus Pastor and overall Serve Teams on campus load-in, load-out, and shared-space coordination.
  • Ensure all youth environments are safe, organized, and ready before doors open, and fully reset after gatherings.


Scheduling and Admin

  • Serve as primary manager for scheduling and coordination of Youth and Young Adult ministry environments, including shoulder-tapping, onboarding, training, and scheduling through COTR platforms.
  • Develop processes that improve team communication, administrative efficiency, and impact for Serve Team members.
  • Create and maintain an annual ministry budget for Youth and Young Adults in coordination with the Campus Pastor and Central finance team.
  • Manage online platforms for youth and young adult ministries (event registration, communication tools, and database accuracy).


Pastoral Care

  • Effectively communicate the Purpose, Vision & Values of COTR to students, young adults, and Serve Team members.
  • Develop and oversee all aspects of Youth & Young Adults Ministries through pastoral leadership and care.
  • Disciple and mentor Serve Team members by nurturing a Christ-centered culture of discipleship and community.
  • Provide oversight of youth and young adult calendaring, planning, weekly scheduling, and communications.
  • Ensure the theological integrity and biblical grounding of all teaching, curriculum, and ministry activities.


Expectations (Other):

  • Care for Serve Team members, students, and young adults in a respectful and Christ-like manner.
  • Function in a manner worthy of your calling as a minister of the Gospel.
  • Protect the reputation and integrity of others through strict confidentiality and accountability.
  • Develop leaders and provide leadership in areas of responsibility.
  • Willingly and consistently participate in campus setup and tear-down rhythms.
  • Act with integrity in all public and private dealings on behalf of COTR or otherwise.
  • Be discrete and discerning regarding sensitive information to which you may be privy.
  • Manage additional responsibilities as assigned and/or agreed upon.


Qualifications:

  • Born-again, baptized, full of the Holy Spirit, and living under the lordship of Jesus.
  • Minimum of three to five years of leadership experience in a church environment (youth or young adult ministry strongly preferred).
  • Current screening form and background check on file.
  • Passion for and demonstrated experience discipling students and young adults.
  • Comfortable and effective working in a portable church / setup-and-tear-down environment (school gym or similar shared space).
  • Ability to lift and move equipment (up to approximately 40–50 lbs) as part of regular weekly ministry rhythms.
  • Delegation and administrative gifting; strong organizational skills.
  • Visionary and entrepreneurial gifting with the ability to execute vision in a temporary space.
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Creative, solution-based problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to recruit, train, supervise, inspire, and care for Serve Team members.
  • Strong relational skills and ability to connect with teenagers and young adults.

title: AI Engineer/Scientist
description:
About Nightfall:

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem - former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others.

About the role:

At Nightfall AI, we’re building the future of data security with machine learning at its core. Our AI systems detect and prevent data leaks in real time for leading organizations.

We’re looking for a motivated, highly talented engineer to join our AI Engineering team. You’ll work with world-class engineers to design and enhance the AI models that power our security products. Learn how to build and scale the underlying system that hosts these models.

If you love solving hard problems, experimenting with the NLP model architectures, latest LLMs, eager to dive deep into the internals of the underlying systems, and ultimately make a real impact — this is your chance to jump in early and grow fast.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and ship the AI systems that power Nightfall’s Security products.

  • Work hands-on with Python to analyze data, experiment with new natural language or other model architectures, fine tune models, benchmark and monitor model accuracy, build automation for automated training and deployment, real-time inferencing, or designing agentic workflows.

  • Work hands-on with Go to build the microservices that ingest and process data at scale through the use of streaming infrastructure, distributed caching, and highly concurrent execution.

  • Collaborate across engineering and product to turn ideas into live AI features

  • Participate in the team's oncall rotation to help drive operational excellence

You’re a Great Fit If You:

  • 5+ years of industry experience with a graduate degree in Computer Science or Engineering with rigorous coursework in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science or related field.

  • Code fluently in Python, and Go (or C++ or Java) with a solid understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms.

  • Hands-on experience with building Deep learning models and taking them to production at large scale, including complex software engineering in delivering end-to-end AI projects

  • Hands-on experience in building Agentic workflows and using

  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-ownership environments.

  • Are excited to learn from experienced mentors and level up quickly.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with building models in Pytorch or other frameworks to solve complex problems in NLP or other domains, including fine-tuning LLMs or building agentic workflows around them

  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP and experience with systems such as Kafka, Redis, Postgres, etc.

  • Hands-on experience with MLOps for training, inferencing, evaluation, monitoring and deployment

  • Hackathon wins, research papers, or open-source contributions.

Why Nightfall

  • Work with a tight-knit team of AI/ML builders who ship fast and mentor deeply.

  • Get hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI systems at scale.

  • See your models make an immediate impact in real-world security applications.

  • Hybrid schedule (3 days in-office) working out of our Bangalore office.

If you’re ready to go beyond theory and build AI that matters — come join Nightfall.

Environment

Nightfall AI takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation

Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits & perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter.

An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Grade 2 Podiatrist to join the Podiatry Department at St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne on a fixed-term, part-time basis. Based primarily at St George's Hospital in Kew, this role provides podiatry services across the Community Rehabilitation Centre, Falls & Balance Clinic, Berengarra Aged Care Facility and subacute inpatient services. The Falls & Balance Clinic operates on Wednesdays, while the remaining workdays offer flexibility. There may also be opportunities to work in acute services at St Vincent's Hospital Fitzroy as service needs arise. You will work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team to deliver high-quality, person-centred podiatry care across a diverse patient population.

Grade 2 Classification (CM7–CM8): $90,235 – $103,724 per annum, pro rata for part time.

As a Grade 2 Podiatrist, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive podiatry assessment, treatment, evaluation and discharge planning

  • Deliver evidence-based care to patients across outpatient, subacute and residential aged care settings

  • Support safe and effective patient transitions across the continuum of care

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimise patient outcomes

  • Supervise and support undergraduate podiatry students

  • Maintain accurate clinical documentation and participate in quality improvement activities

About You

You will bring:

  • Current registration as a Podiatrist with AHPRA

  • A minimum of two years' experience in an acute and/or subacute hospital setting

  • Demonstrated experience in high-risk foot management

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and teamwork skills

  • The ability to work autonomously while contributing positively within a multidisciplinary team

  • A current Victorian Driver Licence

  • A current National Criminal History Check (or willingness to obtain)

What We Offer

Working at St Vincent's means becoming part of a values-driven organisation committed to delivering exceptional patient care while supporting your professional growth and wellbeing.

You'll enjoy:

  • Salary packaging benefits

  • A supportive and collaborative multidisciplinary team

  • Ongoing professional development opportunities

  • Access to Fitness Passport

  • Employee wellbeing initiatives and programs

  • A culture of continuous learning and improvement

About the Service

The Podiatry Department and High Risk Foot Service delivers comprehensive interdisciplinary podiatry care across acute, subacute, residential aged care and correctional health settings. Services operate Monday to Friday across multiple locations including St Vincent's Hospital Fitzroy, St George's Hospital Kew and a range of community-based sites, providing specialised care for patients with complex foot health needs.

Working at St Vincent's

St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne is a leading teaching, research and tertiary health service. We are committed to providing compassionate, high-quality care while advancing clinical excellence through innovation, education and research. Our values of Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence guide everything we do.

title: SAP SuccessFactors Consultant
description:
About the Role


Turium AI is looking for an experienced, implementation-certified SAP SuccessFactors Consultant to join our Hyderabad team and support the design, configuration, implementation and ongoing improvement of enterprise HR and payroll solutions.

This is a hands-on consulting role. We are looking for someone who can work directly with customers and delivery teams, understand business requirements, configure SuccessFactors modules, troubleshoot issues and take ownership of delivery. This is not a position focused only on high-level architecture or documentation.

You will work across SAP SuccessFactors, enterprise integrations and Turium AI products to help customers modernise, automate and improve their HR processes. You will collaborate with teams across India and Australia and support major enterprise transformation programs.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead workshops with HR, payroll, IT and business stakeholders.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into practical SuccessFactors solutions.
  • Configure, test and deploy SAP SuccessFactors modules.
  • Support implementations, upgrades, enhancements and production issues.
  • Prepare configuration workbooks, functional specifications, process documentation and test materials.
  • Configure workflows, business rules, permissions, notifications and approval processes.
  • Manage role-based permissions and security configurations.
  • Support data migration, validation and reconciliation activities.
  • Design and support integrations with payroll, finance, identity-management and third-party systems.
  • Work with SAP Integration Suite, APIs, OData services and middleware teams.
  • Perform system testing and integration testing and support user acceptance testing.
  • Investigate defects, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Support cutover, go-live, hypercare and post-production stabilisation.
  • Deliver customer demonstrations, end-user training and knowledge-transfer sessions.
  • Coordinate with distributed delivery teams across Hyderabad, Australia and other locations.
  • Identify opportunities to automate HR processes using Turium AI products and capabilities.


Relevant SuccessFactors Modules


Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following:

  • Employee Central
  • Employee Central Payroll
  • Recruiting and Onboarding
  • Performance and Goals
  • Compensation
  • Learning Management System
  • Time Tracking and Time Off
  • Succession and Development
  • Workforce Analytics and Reporting


Required Experience


  • At least four years of hands-on SAP SuccessFactors consulting or implementation experience.
  • Current SAP SuccessFactors certification relevant to the candidate’s functional specialisation.
  • Experience delivering at least two end-to-end SuccessFactors implementations or major upgrades.
  • Strong functional configuration experience in Employee Central and at least one additional module.
  • Good understanding of HR, payroll, onboarding and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Experience configuring workflows, business rules, MDF objects, foundation objects and role-based permissions.
  • Experience with data migration tools, Integration Center, APIs and reporting.
  • Ability to prepare functional specifications and work effectively with technical developers and integration teams.
  • Strong troubleshooting, stakeholder-management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership and remain accountable for assigned deliverables.
  • Experience working with distributed or offshore delivery teams.


Desirable Experience


  • Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications across multiple modules.
  • Experience with Employee Central Payroll or Indian and international payroll requirements.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP or SAP Integration Suite.
  • Experience integrating SuccessFactors with identity platforms, payroll systems, finance systems and other enterprise applications.
  • Experience working with large enterprise or government customers.
  • Understanding of privacy, security, audit and data-residency requirements.
  • Experience supporting customers across Australia, India or other international markets.
  • Interest in applying AI and intelligent automation to HR processes.


What We Are Looking For


We are looking for a practical, hands-on consultant who is comfortable working directly in the system.

You should be able to communicate confidently with customers, HR teams, payroll stakeholders, developers and integration specialists. You will be expected to take ownership from requirements gathering and configuration through testing, go-live and post-production support.


You should bring:


  • Strong attention to detail.
  • A practical approach to problem-solving.
  • Confidence working directly with customers.
  • A willingness to take accountability for delivery outcomes.
  • The ability to work effectively across distributed teams.
  • Curiosity about how AI can improve HR, payroll, recruitment and employee experience.


Why Join Turium AI?


  • Work on major enterprise and transformation programs.
  • Combine SAP expertise with advanced AI and automation capabilities.
  • Collaborate with delivery teams across India and Australia.
  • Work directly with senior customer stakeholders.
  • Help shape intelligent HR and workforce solutions.
  • Join a fast-growing Australian AI and enterprise technology company with a growing Hyderabad delivery capability.


How to Apply


Please apply with your CV and include details of:


  • The SuccessFactors modules you have configured.
  • Your current SAP SuccessFactors certifications.
  • The end-to-end implementations or major upgrades you have delivered.
  • Your experience with integrations, payroll and data migration.
  • Your current location and availability to work from Hyderabad.

title: Sr. Buyer
description:
Job Summary

Sr. Buyer is responsible for procuring, at minimum total costs, the necessary materials, components and/or sub-assemblies to manufacture saleable products. Develop suppliers to meet our delivery, cost and quality requirements while maintaining assigned inventory levels.

Education and Experience

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • The position requires a working knowledge of commodities purchased, supply sources, contracting methods and strategies, and Company products and components.

  • Proficient user of computers and computer software.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous work and/or internship experience in Supply Chain Management.
  • CPSM or CPM certification, preferred.
  • Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software.
  • Familiarity/experience with lean manufacturing, Kaizen events, and continuous improvement techniques (e.g., RCCA, Six Sigma methodology).
  • Working knowledge of AS9100, ISO-9001.
  • Use of and deployment of electronic data interchange procurement and continuous replenishment methods.
  • Excellent planning, interpersonal, and communication skills are required.
  • Results driven with excellent project and time management skills.
  • APICS or ISM certification preferred.

title: Research Fellow - Department of Applied Health Sciences - 107775 - Grade 7
description:
Position Details

Department of Applied Health Sciences, School of Health Sciences, College of Medicine and Health

Location: University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham UK

Full time starting salary is normally in the range £36,636 to £46,049 with potential progression once in post to £48,822

Grade: 7

Full Time, Fixed Term contract up to July 2028

Closing date: 26th August 2026

UK travel may be required for this role

Background

This multidisciplinary project is based on a multi-method design, focusing on the experiences of children, adolescents and their immediate caregivers who are participating in Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) screening initiatives in Europe and the UK; and is an ancillary study to the EDENT1FI programme (European action for Diagnosis of Early Non-clinical Type 1 diabetes For disease Interception) (). The research fellow is sought to support the UK component which is linked to the existing T1D screening program scaled up nationally by the Department of Immunology and Immunotherapy at the University of Birmingham. Screening is being considered as an appropriate health intervention, which identifies the disease pre-symptomatically and provides guidance on managing the early stages of T1D.

Although there is a recognised need to address the psychological experiences of those undergoing screening, much of the work has been with parents; we know much less about the children and adolescents who are being screened. This project’s primary research design utilises mixed methods with quantitative surveys and qualitative methodology focused on creative, interactive and age-appropriate methods of investigating experiences of the screening. The qualitative element of the study, including interviewing and ethnographic play-based activities, is central to achieving an in-depth insight into children’s experiences.

The research fellow will work closely with Dr Olga Boiko (Applied Health Sciences) at the University of Birmingham in collaboration with the international research team of clinicians, psychologist and sociologists as well as researchers from Poland and Portugal who will also undertake data collection in their respective centres. This is an opportunity to join a vibrant multidisciplinary project which is aiming to deliver high quality research in paediatric public health that will lead to identifying support for those with early T1D diagnosis.

Role Summary

  • Recruitment of participants and co-ordinating recruitment activities
  • Data collection (family engagement, interviews, play-based activities, questionnaires)
  • Overseeing and checking transcription of interviews
  • Analyse and interpret research findings and results
  • Patient and public involvement
  • Co-ordinate advisory group meetings and oversee minute taking/meeting record keeping
  • Draft and dissemination study outputs and contribute to impact activities
  • Collaborate with the wider research team to ensure the project objectives are met
  • Contribute to generating funding

Main Duties

  • Collect research data; this may be through a variety of research methods, such as ethnography, play-based activities, research interviews and validated questionnaires, both in-person and virtually
  • Analyse and interpret data using qualitative analysis methods
  • Contribute to developing new models, techniques and methods
  • Apply knowledge in a way which develops new intellectual understanding
  • Contribute to research-related administration
  • Contribute to public engagement activities related to the project, under supervision of the principal investigator
  • Develop impact toolkits and present research outputs, including drafting academic publications or parts thereof, for example at seminars and as posters
  • Provide guidance, as required, to support staff and any students who may be assisting with the research
  • Deal with problems that may affect the achievement of research objectives and deadlines
  • Promote equality and values diversity acting as a role model and fostering an inclusive working culture
  • Contribute to writing bids for research funding
  • Flexible/hybrid working pattern can be considered

Person Specification

  • A PhD (or near to completion) relevant to the research area (psychology, sociology, education), or equivalent PhD level qualifications
  • Well-grounded practical experience of developing, delivering, analysing and writing up qualitative research in health including interviewing, and/or observations and creative methodologies
  • Experience in research with children or willingness to undertake related training
  • High level analytical capability to interpret qualitative evidence using qualitative data analysis software (such as NVivo)
  • Excellent communication skills and capacity to collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholder groups such as families, children, other researchers and members of the public
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills in relation to research
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly to a range of groups including public audiences
  • Good IT skills (including MS Office, email, Teams, electronic survey platforms)
  • Ability to assess resource requirements and use resources effectively
  • Contribution to the planning and organising of the research programme and/or specific research project
  • Knowledge of the protected characteristics of the Equality Act 2010, and how to actively ensure in day-to-day activity in own area that those with protected characteristics are treated equally and fairly
  • Able to travel within the Midlands region for data collection (travel expenses covered)
  • Evidence of research outputs (papers published in peer reviewed journals, conference presentations)
  • Experience of engaging directly in UK research governance and ethical approval processes is desirable.

DBS required

The University is committed to safeguarding and we promote safe recruitment practice, therefore all associated pre-employment checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed. Due to the nature of the work undertaken in this role all successful applicants will be subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS clearance prior to appointment.

Further particulars can be found here

Informal enquiries to Olga Boiko, email: o.boiko@bham.ac.uk

Use of AI in applications: We want to understand your genuine interest in the role and for the written elements of your application to accurately reflect your own communication style. Applications that rely too heavily on AI tools can appear generic and lack the detail we need to assess your skills and experience. Such applications will unlikely be progressed to interview.

We believe there is no such thing as a 'typical' member of University of Birmingham staff and that diversity in its many forms is a strength that underpins the exchange of ideas, innovation and debate at the heart of University life. We are committed to proactively addressing the barriers experienced by some groups in our community and are proud to hold Athena SWAN, Race Equality Charter and Disability Confident accreditations. We have an Equality Diversity and Inclusion Centre that focuses on continuously improving the University as a fair and inclusive place to work where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We are also committed to sustainability, which is a key part of our strategy. You can find out more about our work to create a fairer university for everyone on our website.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineering Technician - Instruments Team
description:
Description of Position:

The Future Forward group within Intuitive Surgical is searching for a Senior Mechanical Engineering Technician with a focus on the mechanical design of next generation surgical robot instruments. This role is an exciting opportunity to join a small and innovative team in the early phases of product development.

Joining Intuitive Surgical means joining a team dedicated to using technology to benefit patients by improving surgical efficacy and decreasing surgical invasiveness, with patient outcomes as our highest priority. The Senior Mechanical Engineering Technician is responsible for supporting a team of mechanical engineers developing new products at Intuitive. The ideal candidate will be fully proficient in all typical instrument manufacturing processes. The candidate should be comfortable working with minimal supervision, and with minimal work instructions and be able to take ideas from R&D engineers and figure out how to build fully functional instrument prototypes. In addition, the individual will assist with developing and maintaining a clean and well-organized engineering lab environment that includes robotic instruments, rapid prototype machines, tools, fixtures, prototypes, and supplies. A strong sense of integrity, care, and attention to detail is required as well as a commitment to developing products of the highest quality.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Assisting with all aspects of early prototype builds, including fabrication and assembly, procurement and inspection of materials, rework of components, troubleshooting, and repair of prototype instruments

  • Assembling prototypes per engineering design/instructions

  • Work alongside engineers to fabricate and modify components using standard prototyping and manufacturing equipment, such as lathe, mill, and laser welder

  • Debugging and performance testing of engineering prototypes

  • Collecting, recording, and reporting test results

  • Preparation of prototype instruments and accessories for benchtop testing and pre-clinical lab evaluations, organizing, overseeing, and collaborating with other groups to assemble and test prototypes.

  • Creating prototype test and assembly fixtures, and providing input for the design of production fixtures

  • Providing input for protocols and reports for engineering, qualification, and verification studies

  • Setup, organization, and maintenance of engineering lab and equipment

  • Documenting assembly procedures and training other technicians on assembly. Assisting in knowledge transfer to other groups / teams.

Skills/Job Requirements:

  • Minimum 8 years' experience supporting a mechanical engineering group in a product development organization

  • Minimum Associate of Science degree, or equivalent work experience

  • Hands-on skills and knowledgeable in prototyping and manufacturing methods, including machine equipment, laser welding, soldering, microscopic wire and cable stripping, and adhesive bonding.

  • Manual dexterity to assemble small components, with microscope or similar magnification

  • Knowledge of catheter materials and manufacturing processes including laminating, braiding, bonding, flaring, and tipping.

  • Ability to inspect components using metrology equipment (including calipers, micrometers, vision systems, CMM)

  • Computer skills in Microsoft Office required, Solidworks experience desired

  • Excellent organizational skills

  • Able to work independently

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

title: Integration Engineer II
description:
Integration Engineer II, AI & Engineering/Engineering as a Service

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026.

Work You'll Do

As Integration Engineer II you will have hands-on integration development skills to develop solutions streamlining business processes working with internal teams, near-shore, off-shore technologists and vendor relationships. You will be part of API management strategies to enable seamless communication between applications. You will work across geographies with accountability for the success, effectiveness and delivery of multiple work streams, managing a large, dispersed technology team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design end-to-end system architecture spanning frontend, backend, integration layers, and cloud infrastructure, translating requirements into scalable Azure-based solutions
  • Define technical standards, Integration design patterns, and best practices to guide the development team
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and design documents, including data mapping and configuration details
  • Build backend services and APIs using Python (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask), Javascript, Azure, Typescript or using enterprise integration tools like MuleSoft , Apigee, Kong, Workato, BizTalk.
  • Design, build, and integrate RESTful APIs - connecting third-party and internal systems for reliable, consistent data exchange
  • Implement API security (OAuth2, JWT, API keys), versioning, rate limiting, and robust error handling
  • Manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing, testing, and deploying integration processes across Test, UAT, and Production environments
  • Monitor integration performance, proactively troubleshoot issues, and provide expert-level post-deployment support
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize data flows and ensure adherence to integration best practices
  • Take ownership of assigned projects, manage stakeholder expectations, and mentor junior team members toward successful delivery

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology or a related field.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) for building backend services and APIs
  • Proven experience designing and implementing integration solutions connecting disparate systems, applications, and data sources across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and architectural styles (e.g., point-to-point, hub-and-spoke, event-driven, pub/sub, ESB, iPaaS)
  • Hands-on experience with API design and development, including RESTful services, SOAP, and/or GraphQL
  • Working knowledge of API security standards and protocols (OAuth2, JWT, SAML, API keys) and best practices for versioning, throttling, and error handling
  • Experience with enterprise integration platforms/tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong, Workato, BizTalk, Boomi, or equivalent)
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud-native architecture and deployment practices
  • Solid understanding of data mapping, transformation, and orchestration techniques across heterogeneous systems
  • Experience managing the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including CI/CD pipelines, testing strategies, and deployment across multiple environments (Dev, Test, UAT, Production)
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex integration and performance issues
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and explain them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to create clear technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, specifications, and data mapping references
  • Experience leading or mentoring junior developers, with a collaborative approach to working across cross-functional teams
  • Strong project ownership mindset, with the ability to manage priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations independently
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred
  • Exposure to and understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAF)
  • Experience integrating specific enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, HCM, Workday, etc.
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies and architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP).


Wages and Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, the individual, and organizational performance.

title: SMTS, FE OCT CPEE Equip Roadmap Leader
company: MICRON SEMICONDUCTOR ASIA OPERATIONS PTE. LTD.
description:
Micron is seeking an experienced technical leader to accelerate equipment and hardware differentiation, strengthen strategic supplier collaborations, and drive long-term manufacturing capability development across the global Front-End network.

This role will serve as a senior individual contributor within the CPEE organization, working across Process Engineering, Technology Development, Manufacturing, Procurement, and external equipment/material suppliers to identify, evaluate, and deploy breakthrough technologies that improve factory capability, productivity, cost competitiveness, and technology readiness.

The successful candidate will combine deep semiconductor process and equipment knowledge with strong leadership, influence, and execution skills to bridge technology innovation and high-volume manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Advancement & Technology Differentiation

  • Lead identification, evaluation, and deployment of differentiated equipment and hardware innovations for high volume manufacturing readiness

  • Develop and proliferate artificial intelligence and equipment automation

  • Drive collaboration with strategic suppliers to influence future equipment architecture, subsystem design, and technology roadmaps.

  • Develop strategies to improve equipment capability, reliability, throughput, yield, sustainability, and cost efficiency.

Manufacturing Roadmap Management (MRM)

  • Develop and maintain multi-year manufacturing capability roadmaps aligned with Micron technology and business objectives.

  • Bridge Technology Development and High Volume Manufacturing organizations to accelerate deployment of new capabilities.

  • Identify capability gaps and define improvement plans required to support future nodes and manufacturing challenges.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment and execution across global sites.

Strategic Supplier Engagement

  • Serve as a senior technical interface between Micron and key equipment/material suppliers.

  • Benchmark industry technologies and identify emerging opportunities.

  • Build technical partnerships that accelerate innovation and create competitive advantage.

  • Coordinate cross-functional supplier initiatives involving engineering, procurement, operations, and technology development teams.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical direction across multiple process and equipment domains.

  • Influence technical decisions across organizational boundaries through data-driven analysis and collaborative engagement.

  • Mentor engineers and emerging technical leaders.

  • Promote systematic problem solving, innovation culture, and technical excellence.

Minimum Qualifications

  • PhD with 8+ years, MS with 12+ years, or BS with 15+ years of semiconductor industry experience.

  • Demonstrated experience in semiconductor process development, equipment development, integration, advanced manufacturing, or technology commercialization.

  • Strong understanding of front-end semiconductor manufacturing and process/equipment interaction.

title: Superintendent, Automation, Electrical & Measurement
description:
Crescent is a differentiated U.S. energy company committed to delivering value through a disciplined, returns-driven growth through acquisition strategy and consistent return of capital. Our long-life, balanced portfolio combines stable cash flows from low-decline production with a deep, high-quality development inventory.

Crescent is a top three producer (by gross operated production) in the Eagle Ford basin. Crescent’s leadership is an experienced team of investment, financial and industry professionals that combines proven investment and operating expertise. For more than a decade, Crescent and our predecessors have executed on a consistent strategy focused on cash flow, risk management and returns. Through disciplined and accretive investments, we have successfully tripled the size of our company since going public in December 2021 while maintaining a strong balance sheet.

Position Summary:

The Superintendent, Automation, Electrical & Measurement (AEM) – is responsible for leading the safe, reliable, and cost-effective execution of automation, electrical, instrumentation, SCADA, communications, and measurement activities across Crescent Energy's Permian Basin region. This position provides leadership for field Automation, Electrical, and Measurement personnel while ensuring production facilities, well sites, saltwater disposal systems, water infrastructure, compressor stations, and associated equipment operate safely and reliably.

The Superintendent partners closely with Production Operations, Facilities Engineering, Drilling, Completions, Production Engineering, IT/OT, Production Accounting, HSE, Supply Chain, and Regulatory teams to maximize production uptime, improve equipment reliability, and support Crescent Energy's operational growth throughout the Permian Basin.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

  • Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development to AEM foremen, technicians, and other assigned personnel across the Permian Basin.
  • Establish regional priorities and allocate company and contractor resources to meet production, reliability, project, and emergency-response needs.
  • Set clear performance expectations; manage employee performance, competency development, training, succession planning, and career progression.
  • Build a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, ethical conduct, and continuous improvement while promoting effective communication across field teams.
  • Participate in workforce planning, recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, organizational design, and after-hours coverage planning.
  • Select, direct, and evaluate contractors based on safety, technical quality, cost, schedule, reliability, and adherence to Crescent standards.

Automation, SCADA & Field Communications

  • Oversee the design, programming, installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of PLCs, RTUs, HMIs, SCADA systems, telemetry, control logic, and associated instrumentation.
  • Ensure automation systems provide reliable monitoring, alarm management, remote control, data capture, and operational safeguards for wells, facilities, compression, water systems, and disposal assets.
  • Lead automation upgrades and evaluate technology that can safely reduce downtime, eliminate repetitive work, improve surveillance, and increase production efficiency.
  • Oversee field communications infrastructure, including licensed and unlicensed radio, microwave, wireless networks, backhaul, routing and switching, towers, antennas, and supporting power systems.
  • Coordinate with IT/OT and cybersecurity teams to maintain secure, supportable industrial networks, controlled access, backups, configuration standards, and recovery capability.
  • Ensure critical communications and SCADA outages are promptly diagnosed, escalated, communicated, and resolved; maintain practical response and contingency plans.
  • Maintain accurate network, configuration, asset, inventory, licensing, and as-built documentation and ensure applicable FCC, FAA, and tower-safety requirements are met.

Electrical Systems

  • Ensure the safe and reliable operation of medium- and low-voltage power distribution systems supporting Permian Basin production assets.
  • Oversee installation, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, variable frequency drives, motors, generators, protective devices, backup power, and solar-powered systems.
  • Provide technical oversight for load studies, utility load sheets, service installations, protective-device selection and coordination, arc-flash requirements, and applicable electrical codes.
  • Coordinate planned electrical outages, commissioning, startup support, storm recovery, and unplanned outage restoration with Operations, Engineering, utilities, and contractors.
  • Support power-cost and electrical-billing reviews, allocation accuracy, demand management, and projects that improve power reliability or reduce operating cost.
  • Conduct field and system audits to verify equipment integrity, technician competency, documentation quality, and compliance with Crescent electrical standards and safe work practices.

Measurement

  • Ensure accurate, ethical, and auditable oil, gas, and water measurement for custody transfer, allocation, operational accounting, and regulatory reporting.
  • Oversee installation, configuration, maintenance, calibration, proving, witnessing, and troubleshooting of flow computers, electronic flow measurement equipment, meters, LACT units, tank-level systems, analyzers, pressure and temperature devices, control valves, and related instrumentation.
  • Develop and enforce regional measurement practices, calibration schedules, meter records, configuration controls, data archiving, discrepancy-resolution methods, and audit trails consistent with applicable API, AGA, contractual, and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish checks and balances to identify volume, quality, and energy-content discrepancies; ensure material exceptions are investigated, documented, corrected, and communicated promptly.
  • Partner with Production Accounting, Commercial, Engineering, Operations, and purchasers to protect data integrity, resolve disputes, support audits, and confirm measurement requirements are incorporated into contracts and new projects.
  • Promote safe measurement work around pressure, stored energy, hydrocarbons, H2S, traffic, and other field hazards.

Reliability, Projects & Operations Support

  • Provide AEM support for well sites, central production facilities, compressor stations, gathering systems, LACT facilities, saltwater disposal facilities, produced-water gathering, water transfer, and gas-lift infrastructure.
  • Coordinate AEM resources for new well turn-in-lines, facility expansions, infrastructure projects, commissioning, startup, turnover, and post-startup stabilization.
  • Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies and use the company's work-management system to plan, prioritize, schedule, document, and monitor work.
  • Lead or support troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for significant AEM failures, recurring outages, measurement discrepancies, and production losses.
  • Ensure Management of Change requirements, control narratives, cause-and-effect documentation, alarm rationalization, drawings, settings, configurations, and turnover records are complete and current.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with field Operations and provide practical technical options that balance safety, production impact, reliability, cost, and schedule.

Safety, Compliance & Emergency Response

  • Champion Crescent Energy's commitment to safe operations through visible field leadership, pre-job planning, stop-work responsibility, and consistent reinforcement of Life-Saving Rules and company expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable OSHA, NEC, API, environmental, state, federal, contractual, and industry requirements.
  • Maintain effective programs and field execution for Lockout/Tagout, electrical safe work, arc-flash protection, energized work, confined space, line locating, working at heights, and other discipline-specific hazards.
  • Conduct field safety observations, audits, risk assessments, and competency reviews; address deficiencies and verify corrective actions are completed.
  • Participate in incident investigations and learning reviews and ensure lessons learned are translated into standards, training, equipment, or work-process improvements.
  • Provide leadership during storms, power disruptions, communications failures, measurement events, and other operational emergencies, including after-hours response when required.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 10 years of oil and gas operations experience, including at least five years in a leadership or supervisory role.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of production automation, electrical power distribution, instrumentation, measurement systems, SCADA systems, and PLC programming fundamentals.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate work across multiple operating areas.
  • Experience managing contractors, budgets, and capital projects.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands and respond effectively to operational emergencies.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

Working Conditions

  • Regular travel to field locations throughout the Permian Basin is required.
  • Work includes office and field environments, exposure to weather and industrial operating conditions, and the required use of personal protective equipment.
  • Must be able to access operating locations and equipment, including walking on uneven terrain and using stairs or ladders, consistent with job requirements and applicable accommodations.
  • Availability for occasional nights, weekends, and after-hours emergency response is required.
  • Other duties may be assigned based on business and operational needs.

Crescent Energy is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. An overview of this role

As a Senior Deal Desk Analyst, you'll be a key partner to GitLab's Asia-Pacific and Japan (APJ) Sales and Revenue teams, shaping how we structure, quote, and book deals that support our growth. You'll sit at the center of the quote-to-cash process and serve as the subject matter expert for sales-assisted quotes in Salesforce. You'll ensure deal intent is accurately captured in quotes, order forms, and bookings, and help resolve issues before they require systems or information technology support.

You'll act as a trusted advisor, using your knowledge of deal structures, approvals, and contract language to guide deals toward compliant, scalable solutions that help close business. You'll work daily with Salesforce and Zuora Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), or similar tools, to review pricing and products, validate order forms, and troubleshoot issues. When needed, you'll complete manual checks using Google Sheets, Excel, or similar spreadsheet tools.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Ecosystem, and Revenue teams to support accurate annual recurring revenue (ARR) reporting, smooth collections, and data integrity across the revenue lifecycle. In this fully remote, fast-paced environment, you'll consistently meet response service-level agreements, improve quote quality and booking accuracy, and strengthen the trusted relationship between Deal Desk and Sales as GitLab continues to expand its AI-powered DevSecOps platform.

What you'll do

  • Act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource on deal structure, quoting, order form creation, and contract options that support deal closure.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Sales questions related to deal structure, opportunity booking, subscription management, and license delivery.
  • Navigate complex deal cycles alongside Sales and partner with key internal stakeholders to fulfill deal requirements.
  • Own the quote review process, including validating Salesforce opportunities, quotes, and order forms to ensure accurate deal structures, metrics, and downstream bookings.
  • Review sales-assisted contracts from Salesforce for accuracy and intent, confirming that commercial terms, including price locks and billing terms, are correctly reflected and comply with revenue recognition requirements and internal policies.
  • Partner with Sales to interpret deal intent, advise on options within GitLab's pricing and packaging framework, and troubleshoot quoting issues in Salesforce, Zuora CPQ, or related tools before engaging technical teams.
  • Support the end-to-end quote-to-cash process by working with Billing, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Accounting, Ecosystem, and other partners to resolve subscription, invoicing, and collection issues.
  • Analyze deal and quoting data to identify recurring issues, recommend process or configuration improvements, and create clear guidance that reduces errors and rework.
  • Participate in regional sales forecast calls, quarterly business reviews, and end-of-quarter standups, providing clear updates on deal status, risks, and required actions.
  • Work hours aligned with the GMT+10 time zone.

What you'll bring

  • Experience supporting quoting, pricing, opportunity booking, subscription management, and bookings within Deal Desk, billing operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or a similar quote-to-cash function.
  • The ability to provide discounting and pricing guidance, with an understanding of standalone selling price and profitability ranges.
  • Strong CPQ skills and technical knowledge, ideally including experience with Zuora or a similar tool, and the ability to understand how calculations and charges are generated across products and pricing models. Experience with consumption-based structures is a plus.
  • Practical Salesforce experience, including creating and reviewing quotes, managing opportunities, and troubleshooting data or process issues to support accurate booking metrics.
  • The ability to interpret commercial contracts and understand how legal and commercial terms, including price locks and term commitments, affect deal structure, pricing, bookings, and approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy across quotes, order forms, and bookings, including the ability to validate or recreate scenarios using Google Sheets, Excel, or similar tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the initiative to identify the root causes of quote-to-cash issues and partner with systems and cross-functional teams to prevent recurring errors.
  • An understanding of revenue recognition concepts in a software-as-a-service environment and experience partnering with Finance, Billing, Accounts Receivable, Ecosystem, and Revenue teams to support compliant, timely bookings and collections.
  • Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to advise and build trust with Sales teams in a highly collaborative, remote environment.
  • Experience with enterprise deal structures and legal terms that may affect contract structure.
  • The ability to prioritize your workload in line with Sales expectations and changing business needs.

About the team

Our Deal Desk team is responsible for the processes that power GitLab's end-to-end sales bookings, from quoting and deal structuring through contract review, booking, and handoff to billing and collections. We partner closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Billing, and Accounts Receivable to support accurate, timely, and compliant bookings in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

You'll join a highly tenured, trusted group of Analysts and Strategists who serve as the first line of support for quotes in Salesforce, review sales-assisted contracts, and help troubleshoot quote-to-cash issues before they reach our systems teams. Together, we focus on getting the details right, maintaining strong partnerships with our Sales teams, and making it easier for customers to buy and expand with GitLab.

The Claims Senior Casualty Adjuster handles moderate to high complexity claims involving material damage, property and/or liability lines of insurance written by the Interinsurance Exchange in compliance with all regulatory and statutory requirements. The primary functions include liability investigation, coverage evaluation, negotiation strategies and claims resolution of moderate to high complexity claims. Explain benefits, coverages, fault and claims process either verbally or in writing in compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements. Recognize and appropriately address moderate complexity coverage issues.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Mobile App Developer based in Spain.

This role offers the opportunity to lead the development of high-quality mobile applications used by customers worldwide. You will take ownership of Android and iOS development initiatives, driving technical excellence and innovation across mobile products. The position combines hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and collaboration with cross-functional teams. You will guide development practices, improve application performance, and ensure scalable, reliable mobile experiences. Working in a remote and product-focused environment, you will help shape solutions that simplify mobile app creation for businesses and creators. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced mobile developer who enjoys solving complex challenges and mentoring others.

Accountabilities

You will lead mobile application development efforts, ensuring high-quality delivery across Android and iOS platforms while contributing to technical strategy and engineering excellence. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of advanced mobile applications for both Android and iOS platforms.
  • Drive technical decisions and development practices to ensure scalable, reliable, and high-performing mobile solutions.
  • Conduct detailed code reviews across Android and iOS projects, ensuring adherence to coding standards, best practices, and optimization principles.
  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product stakeholders to deliver intuitive and high-quality mobile experiences.
  • Design and implement solutions that work effectively across a wide range of mobile devices and operating environments.
  • Integrate external data sources, APIs, and third-party services into mobile applications.
  • Write and maintain robust unit tests, ensuring reliability, usability, and performance across different scenarios.
  • Monitor live application performance and continuously optimize mobile apps at the code level.
  • Support debugging efforts and resolve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX teams to ensure applications are visually consistent, user-friendly, and aligned with platform guidelines.
  • Stay up to date with emerging mobile technologies, development frameworks, and industry best practices.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, technical improvement, and a culture of engineering excellence within the team.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate is an experienced mobile developer with strong technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and a passion for building high-quality applications. The required qualifications and skills include:

  • 8+ years of experience in mobile application development, with strong expertise across Android and iOS platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kotlin, Java, and Swift for native mobile development.
  • Strong experience with mobile architecture patterns including MVP and MVVM.
  • Proven experience leading development initiatives and conducting effective code reviews.
  • Strong understanding of mobile application performance optimization and best practices.
  • Experience working with APIs, external data integrations, and mobile data management.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks, automated testing practices, and continuous integration/deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with version control tools such as Git, BitBucket, and SourceTree.
  • Strong understanding of Android and iOS design principles, interface guidelines, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Experience working with ViewModel architecture and modern mobile development approaches.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex technical challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Positive attitude, ownership mindset, curiosity, and strong attention to detail.

Benefits:

  • Fully remote work opportunity.
  • Opportunity to work on innovative mobile products with global reach.
  • High level of ownership and influence over technical decisions.
  • Collaboration with an experienced and international team.
  • Flexible working environment that supports autonomy and creativity.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mobile technologies and solutions.
  • Professional growth opportunities through challenging projects and technical leadership responsibilities.

title: Risk Staff Software Engineer
description:
Intuit is a global technology platform that helps our customers and communities overcome their most important financial challenges. We provide tools and products to simplify financial management, earning the trust of over 50 million consumers, small businesses, and mid-market customers worldwide through our innovative solutions.

Intuit Fintech, one of Intuit's fastest-growing business units, is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the technology vision, strategy, and development for the Intuit Fintech Risk Platform. This role is crucial in building robust risk and compliance capabilities while leveraging cutting-edge technologies like GenAI to deliver intelligent applications. The position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge Fintech innovations, advanced analytics, and enterprise-scale development.

If you are passionate about architecting world-class platforms, have hands-on experience with React, Java, Spring Boot, and AI technologies, and are keen to tackle complex payment and risk challenges, this is the opportunity for you!


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and high-performing software solutions for the Fintech Risk Platform, utilizing React for the front-end and Java/Spring Boot for the back-end.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, prioritize features, and optimize risk and compliance capabilities.

  • Drive the development of AI-enhanced applications, leveraging GenAI concepts and frameworks to deliver transformative Fintech solutions.

  • Analyze, identify, and mitigate risks across the Fintech ecosystem by implementing robust compliance measures and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering collaboration and a culture of innovation within the team.

  • Utilize advanced statistical models, AI/ML techniques, and risk analytics to power decision-making and feature development within the risk platform.

  • Partner with product managers to understand analytics needs, define metrics, and implement executive dashboards to monitor platform performance.

  • Build data pipelines and models for risk data, ensuring automation, consistency, and scalability across Fintech systems.

  • Conduct A/B testing and experimentation, interpreting results to optimize platform efficiencies and drive informed decision-making.

  • Stay updated with developments in Fintech and AI technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (Master's degree preferred) or equivalent work experience.

  • 10+ years of professional experience in designing and developing software solutions, with expertise in both front-end technologies (React) and back-end frameworks (Java, Spring Boot).

  • Hands-on experience in GenAI concepts and frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, GPT-3/4, SageMaker, Bedrock) and the ability to integrate AI in practical applications.

  • Prior experience in risk and compliance domains within financial platforms is highly desirable.

  • Strong knowledge of Fintech concepts, including payment systems, risk analytics, and compliance strategies.

  • Advanced proficiency in cloud solutions, particularly AWS, and strong familiarity with modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.

  • Expertise in scripting languages like Python, SQL, and frameworks for data visualization tools.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with strong analytical abilities and data storytelling expertise.

  • Proven experience driving collaboration across engineering, product, and analytics teams to deliver impactful outcomes.

  • Highly motivated and results-oriented individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is comfortable with ambiguity.
